description: June 24 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 1, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a June 24 birthday falls in Cancer, in the first decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: June 24 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Six, the number most associated with home and caretaking, falls in the sign most associated with the same on June 24th. Two degrees into Cancer, in the Moon's own decan, the instinct to nurture is often described as unusually strong. The useful counterweight is self-care: protecting time and energy so the protector is not running on empty.

On June 24 the Sun usually sits at about 2° Cancer, in the first decan, where Moon rules the decan as well as the sign. The Moon rules Cancer and also presides over its first decan, so roughly June 22 to July 1 is traditionally the most lunar part of the year. Feeling comes first here, often before words. Natives of this decan are frequently portrayed as protective, intuitive and deeply attached to home, family and memory. Their moods may rise and fall like tides, which is less a flaw than a rhythm worth learning. A doubled Moon can also mean holding on to old hurts longer than they deserve. Giving care to themselves as freely as they give it to everyone else is often the central lesson.

sections.heading: June 24 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 24th reduces as 2 + 4 = 6. The compound combines the 2's emotional attentiveness and the 4's reliability, feeding into the 6's devotion to home and community. Those born on this day are often described as dependable carers: the one who brings soup, fixes the shelf and remembers what you said last month. Stability in family life tends to matter a great deal to them. As a secondary number, the 24 points towards a gift for creating safe, well-run spaces. Accepting help in return is often their quiet area of growth.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one June 24 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on June 24: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 24 is the 175th day of the year (176th in a leap year). By July 23, 29 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Leo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by June 24, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on June 24 include Lionel Messi (1987), Ambrose Bierce (1842) and Victor Francis Hess (1883).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 24?
faq.answer: June 24 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 24?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 24 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 24th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 24?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a June 24 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 24?
faq.answer: June 24 is also the birthday of Lionel Messi (1987), Ambrose Bierce (1842) and Victor Francis Hess (1883). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
